summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release dated September 8, 2026, announcing that the company will host a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference in New York City on September 15, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. It is purely a routine corporate communication regarding an upcoming investor conference presentation with a webcast and replay. The Form 6-K incorporates the press release by reference into the company's registration statements on Form S-8. No deal terms, financial details, or strategic actions are disclosed. This is an ordinary current report with no transactional significance.
